tools.name: catalog_search_utilities
tools.description: Searches the utility catalog (calculators, converters, checks) by free text in any supported language, optionally within one category, with one tag and/or for one country. Returns up to `limit` matches with slug, title, tagline, category, tag ids, country codes (empty = applies everywhere) and page

tools.name: catalog_list_facets
tools.description: Lists every filter of the catalog search with counts: categories (home and also-in), tags, and countries a utility is specific to. Each item has its id (category and tag ids, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes), its name in the page language and its number of utilities; `everywhere` counts utilities t

tools.name: catalog_get_utility
tools.description: Returns one utility's details: what it answers, category, tags, the countries it is specific to (none = everywhere), page URL, the WebMCP tools its page offers, its server API actions, `privacy` (`local`: what the visitor enters never leaves their browser; `server`: it is sent to the site's server t

tools.name: catalog_describe_tool
tools.description: Returns one utility tool's description and JSON input schema, so it can be run from this page with catalog_run_tool without opening the utility.

tools.name: catalog_run_tool
tools.description: Runs any utility tool from this page, without opening the utility: `name` from catalog_get_utility, `input` matching the schema from catalog_describe_tool. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalog_search_utilities, catalog_get_utility, catalog_run_tool · Public sink: feedback_send · Destructive: catalog_get_utility, catalog_describe_tool, catalog_run_tool, feedback_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: catalog_search_utilities, catalog_get_utility, catalog_run_tool · Public sink: feedback_send · Destructive: catalog_get_utility, catalog_describe_tool, catalog_run_tool, feedback_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
